IS : 11526-1986 

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard gives the nomenciature of piiers, pincers and nippers used for gripping, cutting or 
combined gripping and cutting of objects or wires. Nomenclature for different aspects of the above 
tools, such as component parts, handles, joints for closing pliers, joints for opening pliers, features 
of head, cutters, cutting edges, and shapes of nose and gripping surfaces, have been given in this 
standard. 

For the nomenclature of spanners, wrenches, screw drivers and their accessories, reference may 
be made to IS : 6293-1981 'Nomenclature of the assembly tools for nuts and screws ( first revision )\ 

Wherever two nomenclatures have been given, the first one is according to the Indian Standard on 
the subject and the latter (given in parenthesis) is according to ISO Standard. 

This standard is based on ISO 5742-1982 'Pliers and nippers — Nomenclature', issued by the 
International Organization for Standardization (ISO). Tools referred under No. 211 to 215 and 
No. 307 to 309 are not covered in ISO but Indian Standards are available on them.
